name: 49707 · Alpena, MI
findings: ZIP 49707 (Alpena) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49707 (Alpena) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49707 (Alpena) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 23.6 times the typical level).
